title: Aether Graph Node Type
description: Schema for a registered node type in the Engineering Graph. Node types are data; the kernel's generic mechanics validate, revision, and index them (I-2).

revisioned.description: If true, mutations produce immutable revisions; current state is a pointer.

immutable.description: If true, instances are immutable (e.g., SimulationRun, Result). Treated as always-revisioned.

allowed_states.description: State values for this node type. The kernel recognizes four canonical states (draft, released, superseded, archived); other domain states (proposed, accepted, reversed, running, succeeded, etc.) are permitted as domain-specific extensions. The kernel only ever transitions between canonical states; domain states are advisory.

properties_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the node's typed properties (SDP §3.1).

initial_edges.description: Edges that may legally exist when this node is created.

lifecycle.description: Allowed state transitions and the policy checks that gate them.
